hypotheses.statement: Run 40204378896 failed ONLY in its independent-audit job. Its producer team job succeeded end-to-end (all ten steps success, snapshot persisted), the audit job's 'Independent audit' step ran 2704.0s and failed, 'Enforce audit scope and read gate' and 'Persist audit snapshot' were skipped, integrate was skipped and resilience succeeded. This is the FOURTH consecutive occurrence of the identical signature (40187594111, 40192868113, 40198184759, 40204378896 each 2704.0s) and it matches the checked-in work-quantum wrapper: origin/main:.github/scripts/run-ox-with-retry.sh:22 sets WORK_QUANTUM_SECONDS=2700, line 180 sleeps 15s, line 182 kills at now-start>=2700, line 187 returns 78. 2700 is divisible by 15, so detection lands exactly 2700s after agent start and the GitHub step duration is 2700s + ~4s setup = 2704.0s. No audit branch and no gate exist, so the run issued NO verdict: this is an orchestration/work-quantum failure, not a producer, validation, gate or product failure.
hypotheses.success_rule: All of: team conclusion success with every step success; audit conclusion failure with failing step named 'Independent audit'; that step's duration exactly 2704.0s; the two later audit steps skipped; integrate skipped; resilience success; no refs/heads/cycle/core/evaluation/40204378896/audit ref on origin; the same 2704.0s duration present for 40187594111, 40192868113 and 40198184759; the wrapper's quantum constant and kill branch read from origin/main at the documented lines.
hypotheses.falsified_if: Any producer step failed, or the audit wrote a gate/audit branch, or the failing step is not the independent audit, or the duration differs from the quantum pattern, or the wrapper no longer carries the 2700s quantum/15s poll/exit-78 branch.
